_comment: Golden ProviderItemEnvelope for Linear (#523): one screened issue fetched from the team named by the descriptor's resource_id.
_expected_behavior: accepted — describes a fetched Linear issue without governance, review, or binding authority
_authority_boundary: Provisional alpha provider-fact handoff object. It is NOT Source, SourceSnapshot, SourceEvidence, DecisionCandidate, Decision, ToolRequest, ExternalIngestEnvelope, or event-store authority. content and provider_metadata are screened, non-secret provider facts only.
title: Implement caching layer for graph queries
content: Repeated graph queries on the hot path are re-walking the AST. Add a content-addressed cache keyed by commit SHA.
